reason: Plan Phase 5, the fallback candidate: r52's proven tree shape with the shadow carved to the part of the blade past the cut. The mask stays the controller's first child (r44's accepted insertion point) and the shadow is the mask's sibling, so the walker emits it after the mask's subtree, outside the scissor; the accepted cut clips the bar, and the shadow covers the blade from the cut's edge to the tip in the gauge's own band. Colour #202326 = 0xFF262320, the alpha, blue, green, red order the r52 run proved (it drew 0xFFFF00FF and the copy came out magenta). Written once at the build; the corner colours are not touched per frame. The quad is written every frame at the mask's enter in the units the node's +0x80/+0xb4 pair uses (core's dim_quad: the bar's authored 88.0 covers its rect's whole width, its position pair maps 1:1 onto the rect's corner - the accepted runs log bar=110 38 238 166 with bar_w=88, the r8 run read 284.0 / 224.0 at rect 110 / 38): at 0% on the measured bar the shadow starts 18 units along, is 49.5 authored units wide and samples from column 12 of the band the bar draws; at 50% 54 units, 24.75 wide, column 37; at 100% the hidden width is 1 px in the sprite's empty tail past the tip; with no gauge, width 0. The atlas window follows the bar's live tier band. The mask's enter reads the copy's and the bar's own rect, effective rect, 16-word matrix, position pair and authored pair before each write and prints them as copy state / bar state. r44's accepted cut and its endpoints are unchanged. 22 host fixtures pass; verify PASSED with 33 signature windows. Rebuilt from source, the NRO hash matched the packaged candidate byte for byte. Gameplay NOT RUN.
runtime_test: The accepted cut is r44's, accepted on its Eden run of 2026-10-30. r52 ran on Eden 2026-10-31: the copy is on screen as a full-length magenta blade under the sharpness gauge and stays in place as sharpness decreases and increases and across areas (photo work/modern-sharpness-gauge/visual/r52/r52-magenta-photo.webp, sha256 a6fc2f82b722d66c76642666b4e47e1b17c76841148d993f10bce31453e4e638; log not retained). r54 ran on Eden 2026-10-31 as a REGRESSION: one insertion, then the mask's links gone 8 ms later (root.child=0x0, bar.parent=0x0), 17104 links-lost lines to the log end, 17105 HUD-absent lines, zero fill lines, the mask disabled every frame, so the gauge never clipped (work/modern-sharpness-gauge/runs/r54-eden-2026-10-31.txt, sha256 26ae7bdb1e151959a7ba00534438460b07263dd12128baef8ee0e03827e8b87f). r53 has not been run.

limitations: r54's insertion point is recorded as not safe: with the shadow ahead of the mask on the controller's chain, the row's chain was gone 8 ms after the insertion (root.child = 0, bar.parent = 0) and the gauge row never matched again. The layer is reachable by link order; that position is not. Why the chain went is unread: PHASE2 records the row's real teardown path as still unread
r4 has no runtime test; its lines, the 320-sample budget and the absence of any drawing change are static results.
r2 was built and never run; r3 was run once on Eden and is recorded.
r14 was run once on Eden and failed as reported: the gauge was clipped away from the insertion and the game crashed at the quest end. Its log is the evidence, and the insertion is removed in r15.

r15 was run once on Eden and drew the gauge normally for 740 seconds with no exception; its facts line printed tree_nodes 3 against 4 objects, and its object-list fields were read from the wrong object (the controller's owner field), which is what r16 fixes.

r16 changes nothing on screen: it reads game memory and logs. No drawing, no gauge change, and no cleanup claim (the root-destructor hook fired zero times in the three sessions that logged it). Its Eden run ended in Eden's own shutdown records (maxwell_3d Critical asserts, ForceStop, host SIGSEGV) with zero guest exceptions.
the game's destructor is assumed to free the map block r17 publishes through the cGUIInstance DTI's MT allocator; that free has not been observed, and r17 frees the old 4-word block itself
The per-weapon tier tables live in RomFS weapon data and are not read in this workspace: no weapon data file is extracted here.
The gauge itself is not part of r4.

r25 has not been run. r24's run drew the gauge from the quest start and lost it at an area change, where a mask kept clipping after its links broke; the disable-on-loss path has no runtime evidence, and a mask inserted into a second area's row has never been observed (r24's log ends 12 s after the transition, gauge HUD absent)
r40 has not been run. Its two defaults are the endpoints the r39 log shows applied (right edge 129 px at 0% and 201 px at 100%), read from the tester's run, not from an r40 run.
r42 has not been run. Its fill comes from the player fields Phase 1 verified and the r41 run's accepted geometry; the per-frame fill has not been seen on screen.
r43 has not been run. 128 px at 0% is proven by the r42 log (the tester dragged the start there); 200 px at 100% is the tester's measurement, and that run's box ended at 201.
The thread that runs the draw walker at main+0xa494a0 is unproven, and the run did not change that: no bl site, stored word or DTI property in main names that entry.

The MT `color` word's byte order is unproven, so the dim blade's alpha byte position is an inference. The facts line now prints the bar's four corner colours, so a run pins it next to the colour on screen.

The r44 release bytes are preserved in backups/accepted/modern-sharpness-gauge/r44-before-dim-empty-blade/, runtime UNCHANGED; r45 through r52 are superseded, r52 with its copy seen on screen; r53 is a new candidate and carries no distribution approval.
